## getActivePolicyPath() function

Resolve the absolute path to the active governance policy file.

Delegates to the canonical `resolveActivePolicyPath` helper in `@macts/core` so that enforcement and discovery always read from the same location (`<macts-home>/governance/policy.json`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getActivePolicyPath(): string
```

**Returns:**

string

Absolute path to the policy JSON file.
